svg.title: Brand by brand: where Google’s AI got each chain’s hours
svg.desc: Walmart, the most-asked brand, had its own site cited in 7% of its answers. Starbucks and Chipotle were never cited for their own hours; Publix, Trader Joe’s and Sam’s Club were cited every time. Source: Local AI Registry, https://research.localairegistry.com/local-answer-gap/ (CC BY 4.0)

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: Brand by brand: where Google’s AI got each chain’s hours
Walmart, the most-asked brand, had its own site cited in 7% of its answers. Starbucks and Chipotle were never cited for their own hours; Publix, Trader Joe’s and Sam’s Club were cited every time.
